reasoning_content: App is running. Next is CMS:

action.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
setsid nohup bash -c 'exec just serve --apps=cms < /dev/zero' > /tmp/fin-cms.log 2>&1 &
echo "cms pid $!"
for i in $(seq 1 9); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:39002/ 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "cms UP check $i"; break; }
  echo "check $i: cms=$code avail=$(free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $6}')MB"
  sleep 40
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "cms: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:39002/ 2>/dev/null; free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print "available="$6"MB"}'
